cycles.hypothesis: Hard topology constraint + shared stroke-graph latent lowers soec against the best unconstrained baseline at a FID cost inside the declared acceptability band.
cycles.method_config: stroke-graph diffusion, k=5, hard topology, global+local style, differentiable Bezier renderer, lambda1=0.1

cycles.hypothesis: If cycle 1's legibility is inadequate, raising the content-verifier weight recovers CER without giving up stroke correctness.
cycles.method_config: as cent_r1 with lambda1=0.5 and verifier warm-up over the first 20% of steps

cycles.hypothesis: If cycle 1's style fidelity is inadequate, per-stroke local style plus a longer style-encoder pretraining schedule closes the writer-verification gap.
cycles.method_config: as cent_r1 with local style ablation A3 reversed and style encoder pretrained for 2x steps

levels: anchored to neighbour exits/entries (continuity by construction)

decision_rule.min_margin_definition: join-rate error at least 10 percentage points closer to the writer own rate than the best baseline, at AR within 1 point of that baseline
decision_rule.direction_rule: and continuity direction error at joins lower than a boundary-aware baseline
decision_rule.variance_rule: 95% bootstrap CI of the gap must exclude zero; otherwise inconclusive, not a win
decision_rule.content_gate: AR within 1 point of the best baseline

adopted_from_them.human: user study on style fidelity and writing naturalness

metric_requirements.connectivity: generated trajectories only; image-only baselines cannot report it

composed_protocol.declared_connectivity: a composed baseline lifts the pen at every character boundary, so its connector rate is 0 BY CONSTRUCTION. Report it as declared, never as a measured model property.
composed_protocol.content_scoring: never self-scored: the baseline is told the characters, so AR/CR must come from a recogniser on the assembled output

generation_mode_taxonomy.N: native line model (layout and connectivity produced by the same generator)
generation_mode_taxonomy.ND: native but glyphs placed by a separate layout planner: connectivity cannot arise by construction
generation_mode_taxonomy.C: composed: character/word model plus our composer (layout named: uniform or style)
generation_mode_taxonomy.NR: not runnable here: no code, no weights, no licence, or broken entry point

metric_direction_note: AR/CR = fixed real-trained recogniser applied to GENERATED lines. D_AR/D_CR = recogniser TRAINED ON GENERATED lines, tested on REAL lines. Opposite directions; never placed in the same column.
split_conflict: the literature uses three incompatible Chinese line splits: 816/203 (DiffBrush), 1000/200 (OLHWG), and train-HWDB2/test-ICDAR2013. We adopt 816/203 and state the conflict.

central_claim: continuity at character boundaries should be a CONSTRUCTION (connector control points anchored to neighbour endpoints -> zero positional discontinuity, learned direction) rather than a SUPERVISION TARGET (per-timestep pen-state label). Secondary: connectivity must be measurable in the Chinese regime and in the offline image domain, where no prior metric suite applies.

metric_notes.join_rate_error: defined even with zero positive boundaries (the Chinese case); two systems that join nothing vs a writer who joins nothing score 0
metric_notes.join_f1: reported as UNDEFINED, not zero, when no positive boundary exists
metric_notes.word_space_similarity: NOT_RUN for Chinese: no word spaces (BoundInk reports the same for the OLHWG protocol)
metric_notes.continuity_error: position + DIRECTION mismatch at a join; the existing boundary suite has no smoothness term
metric_notes.offline_connectivity_proxy: ink-only join estimate; its agreement with trajectory-derived GT on paired lines MUST be reported beside any number
metric_notes.csm_naming: CSM-named quantities are our definitions of BoundInk constructs; the released text does not state their formulas
